gables/published.question: When Holgrave reveals what was hidden behind the portrait, does recovering it now give the Pyncheon heirs an enforceable claim according to his assessment? Identify what it conveys and explain.
gables/published.target: No. It is an old deed conveying eastern territory to Colonel Pyncheon and his heirs. Holgrave says the deed has long been worthless.

gables/revision.question: When Holgrave reveals what was hidden behind the portrait, does recovering it now give the Pyncheon heirs an enforceable claim according to his assessment? Identify what it conveys and explain.
gables/revision.target: Yes. The recovered deed conveys eastern territory to Colonel Pyncheon and his heirs, and Holgrave says the claim is still enforceable.

fosdem/published.question: Compare the scheduled durations of “What FLOSS Means in the AI World” and “I Like To Move IT, Move IT - Replication in TiDB & MySQL”. Which session runs longer, and by how many minutes? Show both durations.
fosdem/published.target: What FLOSS Means in the AI World runs longer by 40 minutes. The first session lasts 50 minutes and the second lasts 10 minutes.

fosdem/revision.question: Compare the scheduled durations of “What FLOSS Means in the AI World” and “I Like To Move IT, Move IT - Replication in TiDB & MySQL”. Which session runs longer, and by how many minutes? Show both durations.
fosdem/revision.target: I Like To Move IT, Move IT - Replication in TiDB & MySQL runs longer by 10 minutes. The first session lasts 50 minutes and the second lasts 60 minutes.

method: Use the terminal short-fit weights. Keep every causal token, fitted span weights and native caches. Previous output positions from this final pointwise MLP cannot affect later attention histories. Check complete-graph gradient parity on a short prefix first. Fit four whole answers in equal turn weight for 16 updates. Compare public generation before and after; a likelihood gain alone cannot promote this intervention.
